consumerSite.playerVisibleUse: Sitting at a desk in an office, or in a hearing or committee seat, wherever a chair anchor asks for the seated-at-desk pose family.

figureContext.note: The contacts are the contract and they are normalized, so no pixel canvas is specified here: seatedPelvis at x 0.50 and y 0.62, left and right foot at x 0.37 and 0.63 and y 0.975, tolerance 0.035, feet below the pelvis, and one consistent seat-to-sole span across the set because the runtime scales the whole figure to each chair. Canvas follows whatever the body family's own plates use.

jurisdiction.reason: A body is a body. Desks and rooms are supplied by the scene, and the regional look is carried by environment plates rather than by a figure.

missing: No furniture-free modular body in the project is seated in the desk posture. The `seated-at-desk` pose family is what office, hearing, committee and executive chairs ask for, and nothing can fill it.
notes: No desk and no chair drawn. The room supplies the furniture, and a desk in the body art renders on top of the room's own desk. That is the defect that rules out every existing candidate below.
Every wave-a desk-posture plate has a desk painted across the lap and forearms. Those cannot be machine-separated, because recovering the body underneath would mean inventing it.

The ocd-p71/p76 seated set does not answer this. art/qa/p71/source_intake_dispositions.json rates seated-at-desk PARTIAL in its own words: the seated cells rest their hands on lap, knees or forward in a gesture, none places the forearms at a work surface, so a desk pose would be a reinterpretation rather than a match. ocd_body_adult_fem_seated_gesture_forward_v1 is recorded there as a low forward gesture, not forearms at a surface.

Recorded disagreement, not resolved here: looking at the p76 pixels of that same plate, this thread read the forward arm as a desk-like gesture, which the p71 record authored from those pixels does not. Two observations from one image disagree, so both are written down and the character rendering triage thread is taking a third with a method statement. Nothing is registered as desk posture on either reading until that settles.
That disagreement does not gate this request. The whole ocd set is female adult (ocd_body_adult_fem_*), so even on the reading most favourable to it, the desk posture is uncovered for men.

art/generated/approved/human_candidate_A01_primary_desk_seated_v1.png is genuinely desk-seated and furniture-free, but it is a finished clothed character rather than a modular body, so it is proof the posture is achievable rather than a plate that can be registered.
Guest seating is NOT part of this request; that posture is covered.
Both sexes are needed. Front facing first, since 38 of the 42 seat anchors declare front.

Not promoted as a new request: 'person-production-seated-body' is already in art/requests/asset-requests.json and asks for the same picture, so this record names it rather than adding a second ask for it. Checked 2026-09-22 against the registry the Art Desk reads.
title: A modular body seated at a desk, forearms at an unseen work surface
whyNeeded: Office and hearing scenes are where the game seats people, and every one of those chairs currently has nobody who can sit in it in that posture.
